name: Blight

facts.text: A Blight Controller in the Cursed Forest brings out eight Fire Blights, then four Late Blights, then two Flesh Blights, and only then Blight itself.
Blight is level 70, 30,000 health: 'Bloody bones fly from all directions... forming a single giant skeleton', then 'Blight has taken it's true form! It turns its deadful stare upon you!'
The four-stage blight as a sickness of the wood's earth is Living Server lore.

story: When the court bargain broke in the Cursed Forest, the earth there sickened, and the sickness has a will. It comes up out of the ground in stages, the way a crop disease does. First it burns, as fire blight, a scatter of smouldering things. Then it rots, as late blight. Then it comes as flesh, and that is when the wise go home. And if a band is foolish enough to destroy all three, the blight gathers the bones of everything it has ever killed out of the soil in a whirling cloud and stands up as a single giant skeleton, and turns its stare on them. The Sylvan say that is its true form. Nobody has asked them how they know.
legend: It is a gauntlet, not a fight: eight fire blights, four late blights, two flesh blights, then Blight itself. Pace the healers and the mana across all four waves. Its true form has a dreadful stare; stay spread and do not pull other things in the forest meanwhile.

aggro: The earth splits and something smoulders out.

phases.text: Blight has taken its true form!

death: The bones fall apart. The earth is clean, for now.

lairEntry: The ground is sick here, and it is spreading.

phases.text: Bones fly together into a giant skeleton!

atmosphere.realmFirstKill: Blight is broken. The Cursed Forest earth is clean.

loremasterTopic.text: The sickness of the Cursed Forest's earth. It comes as fire, rot and flesh, and then as a skeleton of every bone it ever took.
